$comment: Single source of truth for the add-on's packs. tools/manifests.ts writes each pack's manifest.json from this file; the scripts read it for pack names in the manual. Never change a uuid: Bedrock identifies imported packs by it.

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 (Behavior)
packs.description: ElleeDog 67 core: the ElleeDog 67 Book manual, Stair Sitting, Creeper Mod and the scripts for every other ElleeDog 67 pack. Required by all ElleeDog 67 packs.

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 (Resources)
packs.description: ElleeDog 67 core resources: the ElleeDog 67 Book and Stair Sitting visuals. Activated automatically with ElleeDog 67 (Behavior).

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Pets
packs.description: Optional: become Carter, Mochi or Casper with the Pet Morpher. Replaces the player definition. Needs ElleeDog 67 (Behavior).

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Pets Resources
packs.description: Optional: pet models, animations and fitted armor. Replaces the player renderer. Keep above ElleeDog 67 Rbow Ore Resources.

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Rbow Ore
packs.description: Optional: Rbow ore, ingots, tools, armor and a spear. Adds ore generation to new chunks. Needs ElleeDog 67 (Behavior).

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Rbow Ore Resources
packs.description: Optional: Rbow ore, item and armor art. Activated automatically with ElleeDog 67 Rbow Ore.

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Ender Mod
packs.description: Optional: Endermen cannot take blocks from protected builds (/elleedog:ender_protect). Replaces the Enderman definition. Needs ElleeDog 67 (Behavior).

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Redstone Guide
packs.description: Optional: craft a Redstone Guide book (1 redstone + 1 leather). Needs ElleeDog 67 (Behavior).

packs.title: ElleeDog 67 Redstone Guide Resources
packs.description: Optional: Redstone Guide book art. Activated automatically with ElleeDog 67 Redstone Guide.
